tables.name: admin_template_library
tables.viewDefinition:
SELECT ce.tenant_id,
    ce.id AS template_id,
    ce.campaign_id,
    c.name AS campaign_name,
    c.icp_segment,
    ce.sequence_position,
    ce.subject_line,
    "left"(ce.body, 150) AS body_preview,
    ce.status,
    count(DISTINCT sent.id) AS send_count,
    round(COALESCE(avg(
        CASE
            WHEN sent.status = ANY (ARRAY['opened'::text, 'clicked'::text, 'replied'::text]) THEN 1.0
            ELSE 0.0
        END) * 100::numeric, 0::numeric), 1) AS open_rate,
    round(COALESCE(avg(
        CASE
            WHEN sent.status = 'replied'::text THEN 1.0
            ELSE 0.0
        END) * 100::numeric, 0::numeric), 1) AS reply_rate,
    ce.created_at,
    max(tv.created_at) AS last_edited_at
   FROM campaign_emails ce
     JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = ce.campaign_id AND c.tenant_id = ce.tenant_id
     LEFT JOIN campaign_emails sent ON sent.template_id = ce.id AND sent.tenant_id = ce.tenant_id AND (sent.status = ANY (ARRAY['sent'::text, 'opened'::text, 'clicked'::text, 'replied'::text, 'bounced'::text]))
     LEFT JOIN template_versions tv ON tv.template_id = ce.id AND tv.tenant_id = ce.tenant_id
  WHERE (ce.status = ANY (ARRAY['draft'::text, 'queued'::text, 'held'::text])) OR ce.template_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY ce.tenant_id, ce.id, c.name, c.icp_segment;
